journal_article.label: Peer-Reviewed Journal Manuscript (期刊论文)
journal_article.tone: Objective, concise, restrained, evidence-led; zero promotional hype or colloquialisms.

tense_guidance.abstract: Past for methods/findings; present for established facts and conclusions.
tense_guidance.introduction: Present for established background; present perfect for research trends; past for specific prior studies.
tense_guidance.methods: Past tense (passive or 'We + past verb' per journal style).
tense_guidance.results: Past tense for observations; present tense when pointing to figures/tables ('Figure 2 shows...').
tense_guidance.discussion: Present for interpretation/implications; past for own findings; preserve all hedges.

journal_article.person: Third person or restrained 'we' (never 'you' or casual 'I think'); avoid 'we can see'.
constraints: Preserve exact hedge tiers and correlation vs causation boundaries.
Enforce Full Term (ACR) on first occurrence.

thesis_dissertation.label: Graduate Thesis / Dissertation (学位论文)
thesis_dissertation.tone: Formal, thorough, structurally explicit, neutral academic prose.

tense_guidance.zh: Formal Chinese academic prose ('本研究采用……', avoid '我们做了……' colloquialisms); unified full-width Chinese punctuation.
tense_guidance.en: Consistent past for experimental/computational work; present for definitions and chapter roadmaps.

thesis_dissertation.person: Use '本研究/本文' (ZH) or 'this thesis/this work/we' (EN); avoid subjective exclamations.

grant_proposal.label: Research Grant Proposal (基金申请书，如 NSFC / NIH / ERC)
grant_proposal.tone: Persuasive yet rigorous and verifiable; forward-looking hypotheses clearly distinguished from established preliminary data.

tense_guidance.background_and_preliminary: Present/past for established literature and preliminary results.
tense_guidance.proposed_aims: Future or intentional ('will investigate', 'aims to clarify', '拟开展……', '旨在揭示……').

grant_proposal.person: 'The applicant / our group / 本课题组 / 本项目' appropriate; avoid empty slogans ('国际领先', 'breakthrough') unless backed by concrete metrics.
constraints: Eliminate Chinese-to-English literal translationese when translating proposals.
Put specific scientific mechanisms and measurable endpoints before generic background.

reviewer_response.label: Point-by-Point Reviewer Response / Rebuttal (审稿回复)

tense_guidance.acknowledgment: Present ('We thank the reviewer for this insightful comment.').
tense_guidance.revisions_made: Present perfect / past ('We have added...', 'Section 2.3 now states...').

reviewer_response.person: First-person plural ('We') preferred; avoid sycophantic excess or dismissive phrasing.
constraints: Preserve exact quote/line/page pointers to manuscript revisions.
Do not overclaim beyond the added evidence.

english_abstract.label: Standalone English Abstract (英文摘要)
english_abstract.tone: High information density, concise, zero filler openers, clear Background-Objective-Methods-Results-Conclusion arc.

tense_guidance.conclusion: Present with exact original epistemic hedging.

english_abstract.person: Third person or restrained 'we'; eliminate 'In this paper, we mainly studied...'.
constraints: Strictly conserve every quantitative metric, p-value, sample size, and hedge qualifier.
Minimize wordiness while retaining all boundary conditions.

bilingual_zh_en.label: Bilingual Chinese-English Polishing & Alignment (中英双语润色与对照)
bilingual_zh_en.tone: Formal academic register in both Chinese and English with 1:1 terminology and semantic alignment.

tense_guidance.zh: Natural academic Chinese ('本文研究了……', '结果表明……'), avoiding English-syntax calques.
tense_guidance.en: Natural academic English restructuring topic-prominent Chinese clauses into clear English subjects and active/passive verbs.

constraints: Re-arrange subject/information focus when translating ZH->EN rather than word-for-word calques.
